text: Access and security - Publisher reports a critical security incident in Bas-Uele (one control point destroyed during a strike; SR195 reported damage at a control point there during a strike, and whether this is the same incident is not printed); logistic and security constraints on burials in parts of Nord-Kivu; low reception capacity in some Ituri treatment centres; IPC gaps found in three assessed Ituri facilities (the continuity of care line repeats SR195); low community engagement and low reporting of community deaths in Bas-Uele, with 0 burials for 2 death alerts; 26 of 50 Bas-Uele laboratory samples non-conforming (52%); and a cumulative of 53 front-line workers infected in Haut-Uele since the start. The security section repeats SR195 verbatim (missing isolation equipment and basic material at several Sud-Kivu control points; no formal sanitary barriers at some Haut-Uele control points). Burials: Nord-Kivu 92 for 94 death alerts; Ituri 69 for 100 alerts (69%), 17 bodies swabbed and 14 postponed; Haut-Uele 4 for 4. No intervention effect is established.
